Laura / Ben / Sara,

I pulled the ledger generation pipeline and a couple quick notes that should explain most small deltas:

- Aggregation window: we aggregate metering events into 1-hour buckets aligned to the tenant's configured reporting timezone (default UTC). Events near the hour boundary are assigned based on event timestamp, not ingestion timestamp.
- Rounding: we round up to the nearest whole unit for invoice rows (we bill by whole inference/embedding units). Metering events are fractional; we keep fractional precision in the raw export but roll to integer for ledger output.
- Retry dedupe: events that are retried within 30s may be collapsed into a single event; this affects noisy ingestion patterns.
- SKU aliasing: historically we had two internal SKU labels ("inference-unit-v1" and "inference-unit-v1-legacy"). Both map to the same entitlement but are normalized in the ledger to "inference-unit".

I'll attach the mapping snippet below (quick CSV-style lines). You can paste this into your recon template.

entitlement_id,raw_sku,ledger_row_id,aggregation_tz,rounding
ENT-4321,inference-unit-v1,LR-1001,UTC,ceil
ENT-4321,inference-unit-v1-legacy,LR-1001,UTC,ceil
ENT-6642,embedding-unit,LR-1002,UTC,ceil

If Sara's CSV is in PDT, that could cause boundary shifts; please confirm.
